head: codex/5566-existing-worktree-bind
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2] Activate reserved claims from existing worktrees
body:
Closes #5566

Allows typed `csdlc-bind` to activate an exact reserved claim from its already registered issue worktree. Relative reservations are resolved from Git's canonical common directory and primary root; exact canonical path and branch equality remain required. Exact claim equality, collision, path-safety, and readiness guards stay fail-closed.

The mandatory review found and drove a P1 fix for unsafe suffix matching. Positive linked-worktree, mismatched-reservation, and adversarial standalone same-suffix regressions all pass; strict all-target Clippy passes. This unblocks truthful #5306 closeout recovery without writing on `main`.
